values.1: soft billowy clouds — classic smooth fractal noise (Basic)
values.6: soft out-of-focus blobs, lower detail — a 'dynamic' smooth family
values.15: denser churned structure with finer grain
values.20: woven diagonal cross-hatch / grid weave — hard structured lattice

ADBE Fractal Noise-0001.note: Perceptually spans soft clouds (low) -> dynamic blur (mid) -> marble/liquid veins (~13) -> woven grid (high). NOT a smooth continuum; distinct look families. Values 4/6/10 are visually identical when STATIC — they differ only under Evolution animation.
ADBE Fractal Noise-0001.caveat: static-frame probe cannot separate temporally-varying members; needs animated probe

ADBE Fractal Noise-0002.note: Value 2 is the outlier: blocky mosaic. 1/3/4 are soft with subtle smoothness differences (interpolation quality).

ADBE Fractal Noise-0006.note: CONTEXT-DEPENDENT: Overflow only affects pixels pushed out of 0..1 range. At default Contrast=100 almost nothing overflows, so values look identical. Re-probe at high Contrast (e.g. 400+) to reveal Clip / Soft Clamp / Wrap Back / HDR behavior.
ADBE Fractal Noise-0006.caveat: param effect gated by another param; needs a high-contrast probe context
